// INERT SOURCE: schedules are declarations; this fixture has no runner.
const sweep = job("orders.sweep", "Cancellation sweep", {
  trigger: { cron: "0 3 * * *", timezone: "UTC" }, handler: sweepCancelled
});
async function sweepCancelled(db) {
  return db.query("SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'");
}
const replay = job("orders.replay", "Manual replay", {
  trigger: { manual: true }, handler: replayCancelled
});
function replayCancelled(input) { return inspectReplay(input.orderId); }
